# Brief: review round 1, numbers reader

Repository: `~/Desktop/projects/gulfstream-delivery-nowcast`. Output: `docs/build/review1_numbers.md`. Write only your output file; never edit the repository. A finding has an id, a file and line, a severity (blocking, major or minor), evidence (a quote or command output), and a concrete fix. No evidence, no finding. Default to wrong under doubt: when you cannot confirm something reads right, report it.

For every sentence carrying a figure in `README.md`, `docs/LINKEDIN_POST.md`, `docs/RESUME_BULLETS.md`, `docs/INTERVIEW_NOTES.md`, `report/note.html` (read its text) and the captions and sentences `site/app.js` builds (load http://127.0.0.1:8766/ or read the code against `site/data.json`), check that the sentence reads its figure right against `results/metrics.json`, `results/holdout.csv`, `results/design.csv`, `results/estimates.json`, `results/live/`, `data/processed/` and `data/guidance.csv`. Recompute any figure you doubt with `.venv/bin/python`. Check that no sentence says the registry estimate "beat" a baseline unless Holm rejects for it and its relative MAE is below 1 (it does not here), and that nothing claims the project counts jets before GD reports them. The spec is §2, §3.4 and §4 of `~/Desktop/prompt library/gulfstream-delivery-nowcast/GULFSTREAM_NOWCAST_PROMPT.md`. Time box: 40 minutes.
